head.description: Orange Push Pop Cured Resin Badder is a smooth, citrus-forward indica-leaning hybrid concentrate with roots deep in LA’s underground scene. Originally bred by seed junkie and pheno-hunted by a legendary trap grower on skid row, this rare cut spent two years in tissue culture before returning to the spotlight-stronger and louder than ever. Each 1g jar features glistening, honey-like badder that delivers a creamy citrus blast on the inhale, with a mellow, flavorful finish. Cold extracted to preserve the full terpene spectrum, this concentrate offers a nostalgic, orange-cream flavor profile wrapped in calming, euphoric effects. A true street gem turned connoisseur classic. Orange Push Pop Wet Badder Concentrate is available now at Highway 90 Dispensary in Marlton, NJ.Highway 90 isn't just a dispensary—it's a destination. Conveniently located at 90 Old Marlton Pike W in Marlton, NJ, at the crossroads of Route 70 and Route 73, Highway 90 is directly across from Marlton Crossing. Serving the communities of Evesham, Cherry Hill, Voorhees Township, Medford, and Mt. Laurel, we offer a welcoming environment for cannabis enthusiasts across the region. Our knowledgeable team is here to ensure you find exactly what you need, whether it's top-shelf flower, potent concentrates, delicious edibles, or soothing topicals.From seasoned connoisseurs to first-time buyers, our commitment to quality, education, and exceptional service makes us Marlton’s go-to recreational dispensary. Conveniently accessible from Cherry Hill and Philadelphia, Highway 90 offers a seamless shopping experience, competitive pricing, and a selection curated with care. Stop by today and experience the Highway 90 difference—where quality meets community, and every visit is unforgettable. Located near the AMC 8, Chickie's & Pete's, and The Promenade, Highway 90 is your closest destination for premium cannabis products.Concentrated cannabis products come in a wide variety of consistencies, compositions, and potencies. Cannabinoids are isolated and removed from plant material via extraction, agitation, compression, or other methods to create generally a very potent product.
